system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

When you summon your Dream Walker its form is more malleable. More surreal. You are able to adjust its form and tweak it to better fit what you originally dreamed it was. Select one of the following Lucid Dream modifications and apply it to your Dream Walker. You can change this modification when you complete a rest of any type.

Elemental

You dream that your Dream Walker was more of an elemental instead of a mythical creature. Their form changes and exhibits some qualities of a single nature release you have access to. If you do not have access to a nature release, you instead roll 1d6 and that is the nature release it is most like for the duration (1: Earth, 2: Wind, 3: Fire, 4: Water, 5: Lightning, 6: Reroll).

Depending on the nature release it embodies, select two jutsu you know of C-Rank or lower with the associated nature release keyword. Those become abilities it can use twice per initiative, each. If you do not have 2 jutsu with the associated keyword, or you had to randomly select via the dice, they instead gain the chosen jutsu based on their nature release association.

Earth Release. Agonizing Thorn (D-Rank), Tectonic Palm (C-Rank)

Wind Release. Slicing Wind Bullet (D-Rank), Great Breakthrough (C-Rank)

Fire Release. Phoenix Fire (D-Rank), Flame Armor (C-Rank)

Water Release. Tsunami Mallet (D-Rank), Hiding In Mist (C-Rank)

Lightning Release. Guiding Bolt (D-Rank), Lightning Rope

Warrior

You dream that your Dream Walker was more of a warrior instead of a mythical creature. Their form changes and exhibits some qualities of a warrior, samurai or even a shinobi. Select two Taijutsu or Bukijutsu you know of C-Rank or lower. Those become abilities it can use twice per initiative, each. If you do not have a combination of two Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, your Dream Walker instead gains one of the following based on their type of your choice.

Brute. Leaf Uppercut (D-Rank), Beast (C-Rank)

Samurai. Yosaku Cut (D-Rank), Disarming Riposte (C-Rank)

Ninja. Crippling Strike(D-Rank), Mikiri Counter (C-Rank)

Vegetative

You dream that your Dream Walker was more of an primal extract of nature instead of a mythical creature. Their form changes and exhibits some qualities of plants or fungi that exude substances used in Medicine. If you have access to Medical Release, you select the type of vegetable. If you do not have access to Medical Release, you instead roll 1d4 and that is the creature/damage type it is most like for the duration (1: Flowers (Poison), 2: Fungi (Necrotic), 3: Moss (Acid), 4: Reroll).

Depending on the plant type it embodies, select two jutsu you know of C-Rank or lower with the associated damage or effects most similar. Those become abilities it can use twice per initiative, each. If you do not have 2 jutsu with the associated damage or effects, or you had to randomly select via the dice, they instead gain the chosen jutsu based on their plant type association.

Flowers. Poisonous Blast (D-Rank), Poison Mist (C-Rank)

Fungi. Necrosis (D-Rank), Vampiric Touch (C-Rank)

Moss. Acid String (D-Rank), Acidic Bolt (C-Rank)
